item.title: Understanding FinCEN’s residential real estate reporting rule | Opinion
item.description: The rule, which is intended to help law enforcement track and prosecute money laundering schemes, may apply to investor LLC purchases, developer lot takedowns, and certain trust transactions. The post Understanding FinCEN’s residential real estate reporting rule | Opinion appeared first on Daily Journal of Commerce.

item.title: Oregon lawmakers create proposal to overcome ODOT shortfall
item.description: To close a $288 million budget gap at ODOT, legislators want to redirect funds and keep positions vacant, avoiding layoffs but delaying projects. The post Oregon lawmakers create proposal to overcome ODOT shortfall appeared first on Daily Journal of Commerce.
